title: Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('Cross-site Scripting') vulnerability in David Lingren…
description: A reflected Cross-site Scripting (XSS) vulnerability exists in David Lingren's Media Library Assistant up to version 3.43. This flaw involves improper neutralization of input during web page generation, which can allow an attacker to execute arbitrary scripts in a user's browser. The vulnerability has a high severity rating with a CVSS score of 7.1.
